verdict.rationale: Glama Chat accepts natural-language input: it turns text descriptions into diagrams, answers questions about uploaded documents, and gives access to many models. However, nothing shows that the core MCP registry, hosting, or gateway can be operated through natural-language commands; those workflows are documented as UI settings, config-file pasting and per-tool toggles. missing for 10: natural-language control of server deployment, gateway or access configuration, natural-language registry search or management, any agent or assistant that acts on the user's Glama account, independent or hands-on corroboration.
